title: Inbound mail announced and handled

steps.exec: python3 "$TASKS_DIR/../scripts/send-mail.py" --config "$MAIL_CONFIG" --agent tester-ds --from-name 'Priya Nair' --subject 'Seminar room booking for 3 October' --body-file "$TASKS_DIR/fixtures/m01-body.txt"

groundTruth.asks: the mail asks which room is booked for the 3 October seminar and whether the projector was requested; it quotes an earlier message from 'Facilities' that says Hollis 224 was pencilled in
groundTruth.spec: §3.13 the announcement shows the thread as one blockquote, newest first, quoted messages under their own headers; handling marks the message read through triggers::resolve; §4.2 the item stays outstanding until resolved

pass: The system bot announced the mail with the body as a blockquote and the quoted Facilities message split under its header; tester-ds's turn called triggers::resolve with the id in the announcement; its reply states what the mail asks and what the quoted message says without claiming a booking it did not make; the /collegium triggers listing afterwards shows nothing outstanding for tester-ds.

checks.text: The announcement post names the sender and subject and renders the quoted earlier message as a separate quoted segment under 'Facilities'.
triggers::resolve was called with the announcement's id and succeeded.
The reply does not confirm, book or invent anything; it reports the question and the pencilled room, and says what a person must decide.
The /collegium triggers output recorded in driver.json lists no outstanding trigger for tester-ds.
